name: Iron Chef ingredients
author: Campaign
description: The dish maker ingredient list: two entrees, three flavors, two side dishes, an aroma and a garnish. Each ingredient's effect is a formula template -- {expr} is evaluated with level (the chef's level) and the count of each ingredient in the dish.

cooking.source: The Iron Chef dish maker (Auto-Cooking tab): two entrees, three flavors, two side dishes, an aroma and a garnish. Each ingredient's effect is the workbook's own formula as a template -- {expr} is evaluated with `level` (the chef's level) and the count of each ingredient in the dish: rice, avocados, spicy, sweet, sour, salty, savory, redMeat, mycoprotein, fish, fowl. The workbook's COUNTIF ranges that exported as #REF! are resolved to the ranges its Combo Bonus column names.

entrees.name: Fish
entrees.effect: +{1 + floor((level + rice * 3) / 5)} dodge AC bonus while swimming and competence bonus on Swim checks.
entrees.combo: Rice side dish counts as +3 levels

entrees.name: Fowl
entrees.effect: +{1 + floor((level + rice * 3) / 5)} bonus to Reflex saves.
entrees.combo: Rice side dish counts as +3 levels

entrees.name: Mycoprotein
entrees.effect: +{1 + floor((level + rice * 3) / 5)} bonus to Will saves.
entrees.combo: Rice side dish counts as +3 levels

entrees.name: Red Meat
entrees.effect: +{1 + floor((level + rice * 3) / 5)} bonus to Fortitude saves.
entrees.combo: Rice side dish counts as +3 levels

flavors.name: Salty
flavors.effect: +{1 + floor((level + rice * 3) / 3)} competence bonus on saving throws against death effects and effects that deal ability damage or ability drain.
flavors.combo: Rice side dish counts as +3 levels

flavors.name: Savory
flavors.effect: +{1 + floor((level + rice * 3) / 3)} morale bonus to their CMD against any attempt to move them out of their currently occupied square (including bull rush, drag, and reposition attempts, but generally not trip attempts).
flavors.combo: Rice side dish counts as +3 levels

flavors.name: Sour
flavors.effect: +{level + rice * 3} acid resistance. Any creature who bites or attempts to swallow whole a creature benefiting from this effect must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC {10 + floor((level + rice * 3) / 2) + level}) or be sickened for one round; creatures automatically regurgitate the target on failure.
flavors.combo: Rice side dish counts as +3 levels

flavors.name: Spicy
flavors.combo: Rice side dish counts as +3 levels

flavors.name: Sweet
flavors.effect: Reducing the duration of all harmful effects (spells, poisons, talents, supernatural abilities, etc.) with a duration less than permanent by {1 + floor((level + rice * 3) / 3)} rounds (cannot reduce below 1 round).
flavors.combo: Rice side dish counts as +3 levels

sides.name: Apples
sides.effect: +{2 + if(level >= 10, 2, 0) + 2 * redMeat} enhancement bonus to their Strength score for the duration of the effect.

sides.name: Avocados
sides.effect: +{2 + if(level >= 10, 2, 0) + 2 * mycoprotein} enhancement bonus to their Intelligence score for the duration of the effect.

sides.name: Melons
sides.effect: +{1 + floor((level + rice * 3) / 3)} competence bonus on saving throws against emotion effects, and adds this bonus to the DC to demoralize them with the Intimidate skill.
sides.combo: Rice side dish counts as +3 levels

sides.name: Bananas
sides.effect: Reduce any bleed damage they suffer by {1 + if(level >= 10, 1, 0)} (minimum {1 - if(level >= 10, 1, 0)}).

sides.name: Berries
sides.effect: +{2 + if(level >= 10, 2, 0)} bonus on saving throws against poison and disease for the duration of the effect.

sides.name: Cherries
sides.effect: +{2 + if(level >= 10, 2, 0)} bonus on saving throws against the fatigued, exhausted and sleep conditions.

sides.name: Grapes
sides.effect: +{2 + if(level >= 10, 2, 0)} bonus on saving throws against the dazzled and blinded conditions. {if(level >= 10, "This also grants immunity to the dazzled condition.", "")}

sides.name: Oranges
sides.effect: Reduce any ability damage or drain by {1 + if(level >= 10, 1, 0)} (minimum 1).

sides.name: Pineapples
sides.effect: Treat an 8 hour rest as a complete rest when determining the effects of long-term care, as the Heal skill ability.

sides.name: Bread
sides.effect: Any meal made using bread as a side dish can be prepared in a mere 1 minute per entree used.

sides.name: Potatoes
sides.effect: +{2 + if(level >= 10, 2, 0) + 2 * redMeat} enhancement bonus to their Constitution score for the duration of the effect.

sides.name: Rice
sides.effect: All numerical effects of the recipe are determined as though the iron chef were 3 class levels higher than he actually is.

sides.name: Broccoli
sides.effect: +{2 + if(level >= 10, 2, 0) + 2 * mycoprotein} enhancement bonus to their Charisma score for the duration of the effect.

sides.name: Carrots
sides.effect: +{2 + if(level >= 10, 2, 0) + 2 * fish} enhancement bonus to their Wisdom score for the duration of the effect.

sides.name: Lettuce
sides.effect: +{2 + if(level >= 10, 2, 0) + 2 * fowl} enhancement bonus to their Dexterity score for the duration of the effect.

sides.name: Cabbage
sides.effect: +{2 + if(level >= 10, 2, 0)} bonus on Constitution checks made to stabilize.

sides.name: Onion
sides.effect: +{2 + if(level >= 10, 2, 0)} bonus on saving throws against curse and mind-affecting effects.

sides.name: Pumpkin
sides.effect: +{2 + if(level >= 10, 2, 0)} bonus on saving throws against paralysis and stunned conditions.

aroma.name: Fetid
aroma.effect: Any creature that ends their turn within 5 feet of a creature who eats this meal must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw (DC {10 + floor((level + rice * 3) / 2) + level}) or become sickened for 2 rounds. A creature who succeeds becomes immune for 24 hours. If used alongside a sour flavor, creatures do not become immune on a successful save{if(sour > 0, " (bonus applied).", ".")}
aroma.combo: Sour flavor (creatures don't become immune); Rice side dish counts as +3 levels

aroma.name: Pleasant
aroma.effect: +{2 + if(level >= 10, 2, 0) + 2 * sweet} circumstance bonus to Diplomacy and Bluff checks.

garnish.name: Chilies
garnish.effect: +{2 + if(level >= 10, 2, 0) + spicy * 2} circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves made to avoid damage from cold and hot environments for the duration of the effect.

garnish.name: Ginger
garnish.effect: +{2 + if(level >= 10, 2, 0) + 2 * sweet} alchemical bonus to saving throws against the nauseated and sickened conditions for the duration of the effect.

garnish.name: Sage
garnish.effect: +{2 + if(level >= 10, 2, 0) + 2 * avocados} circumstance bonus to Knowledge checks made to recall information.
